tasks.name: Port interpreter, procedures and interpreter state
tasks.evidence: Core CI verifies a bounded CE typed-stack interpreter, synthetic procedures and an explicit opt-in native host. A read-only CE game-clock host now executes invented local interrupt procedure bytecode with original setupCall/0x8025 return framing, while the underlying VM remains unchanged; full game-connected script execution is not implemented. Pinned CE executeProc/setupCall local frame can now be safely preflighted and a narrow core-only local procedure body previewed on a cloned Rust VM, recognizing void (0x8021) and value (0x8025) return frames with bounded instructions; Rust core CI 40016555886 passes. Native Fallout callbacks, imported procedures, nonzero arguments and real persistent execution remain unsupported. Rust core CI 40021337051 passed a bounded cloned local CE procedure subset that reads immutable event owner/source/target, clock, MAP-global, GAME_GLOBAL_VARS and saved allocated script-local slots. Unsupported writes and reads requiring CE lazy local allocation error without mutating the installed VM.

The advance planner never mutates a live clock or processes game events; full engine callbacks and native world mutations remain absent. No actual game object pointers or engine callbacks. Synthetic CI run 40002921218 verifies decoded MAP object identity, immutable refresh after actor movement, original-format invented object-table bytes entering a bounded mixed native INT host, and fail-closed unknown object handles. No live engine pointers, original-game scripts, or gameplay acceptance are established. Explicit caller-gated CE op_tile_contains_obj_pid (0x80BB) scans read-only top-level MAP object snapshots using table elevation, tile and PID, without external pointer access or callbacks. Twenty C++/Rust synthetic decisions pass core CI 40004009967. CE self_obj (0x80BC) now works only through an explicitly authorized owner-resolution host; normal VM and unverified spatial/nested/ambiguous owners remain denied. Twenty adapted C++/Rust synthetic comparisons passed CI 40006876485, and installed-VM owner lookup and read-only CLI diagnostics passed core CI 40008030529. No live event dispatch. Explicit opt-in CE source_obj (0x80BD), target_obj (0x80BE), and obj_being_used_with (0x80C0) now read only caller-provided immutable event handles with typed NULL, unknown-handle, and stack-capacity guards; owner-only and ordinary VM hosts reject these opcodes. Core CI 40009363950 passed. No actual scr_set_objs event callback or world mutation. Added bounded detached CE per-script source/target state, action reset, fixed parameter retention and completion cleanup, then validated planned MAP action identities before using event context; core CI 40012639694 passes. No real CE script execution or game callback dispatch. Pure read-only native adapters now accept selected CE object/event/clock and preallocated variable queries in cloned local INT procedure previews; source/target session context stays caller-owned, with engine callbacks, timers and mutation denied. Core CI 40021337051.
